title: lens culinaris subsp. orientalis
intro: Lens culinaris subsp. orientalis, commonly known as green or brown lentil, is a subspecies of the Lens culinaris plant. It is a legume that belongs to the family Fabaceae and is widely cultivated for its edible seeds. The health benefits of green lentil include its ability to help lower cholesterol levels, regulate blood sugar levels, and reduce the risk of heart disease due to its high fiber and protein content. The bioactive constituents of green lentil include polyphenols, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable ingredient in traditional medicine.
